2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a per-CPU stock representation in the page_counter layer, mirroring the existing seven-slot representation from memcg. The new structure, struct page_counter_stock_pcp, preserves all fields and behaviors from its memcg equivalent but adds a backpointer to the base of the percpu stock. The patch also updates the page_counter structure to include pointers to the base of the percpu stock and the owning cgroup_subsys_state. No functional changes are intended in this initial introduction.
